slides.headline: 1) SPOT WHO NEEDS A CHECK-IN BEFORE THEY QUIT
slides.body: Losing a remote employee costs $30,000 on average. This catches it early. "Draft a personal check-in message for a remote employee. They've been quieter than usual lately. Warm, curious, no pressure."
slides.image_prompt: Close tight on two hands over a worn wooden desk: left hand holds a smartphone face-up, right fingertip hovering above the screen — the screen shows a message thread with a single bold red warning-triangle symbol beside one bubble, no legible text; a coffee mug sitting cold and fully untouched to the right, soft warm peach morning window light from the left; documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, natural skin texture, slight film grain; accent: warm amber against muted oak brown.

slides.headline: 2) WRITE A PERFORMANCE REVIEW IN 3 MINUTES
slides.body: HR consultants charge $200 an hour to write these. "Write a performance review for [name]. • Role: [job title] • Strengths: [2-3 things] • Areas to grow: [1-2 things] Keep it fair and specific."
slides.image_prompt: Close on a pair of hands resting on a laptop keyboard, screen showing a completed long document with a bold green checkmark at the top (no readable text), a physical stopwatch lying on the desk beside the laptop with the numeral 3 displayed boldly in its face — clean minimal professional desk; cool blue desk lamp light from the left; documentary news photo, 35mm, natural skin texture, slight film grain; accent: signal blue against warm cream.

slides.headline: 3) TURN STANDUP NOTES INTO A 30-SECOND BRIEFING
slides.body: A 45-minute standup turns into a 3-bullet brief in under a minute. "Read these standup notes. Summarize in 3 bullets. Flag anyone blocked. List one action item per person."
slides.image_prompt: Top-down shot of a bright desk: a loose fistful of crumpled yellow sticky notes on the left, a tablet on the right showing three oversized clean bullet-point dots and nothing else, a hand caught mid-sweep moving from the sticky-note mess toward the clean tablet; vivid teal and white home-office light, airy and bright; documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain; accent: vivid teal against sticky-note yellow.

slides.headline: 4) BUILD A REMOTE ONBOARDING PLAN IN ONE PASTE
slides.body: Bad onboarding costs $3,000 per new hire in lost productivity. "Build a 30-60-90 day onboarding plan for a remote [job title]. Include weekly check-in goals and one deliverable per month."

slides.headline: 5) WRITE ASYNC RULES YOUR TEAM WILL ACTUALLY FOLLOW
slides.body: Remote teams waste 2 hours a day on messages that don't need a reply. "Write async guidelines for a team of [size]. • Response time expectations • Video vs. text rules • Meeting-free blocks"

slides.headline: 6) WRITE YOUR WEEKLY TEAM UPDATE IN 60 SECONDS
slides.body: A weekly update that takes 1 hour to write takes 60 seconds with this. "Write a weekly team update. • Wins: [list] • Blockers: [list] • Focus this week: [list]"
